PREFIX brick: <http://vocab.brickdevice.com#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX ref: <http://w3id.org/brick/ref#>
SELECT ?point ?tsid WHERE {
  ?zone brick:hasSubclassOf* brick:Zone ; rdfs:label "Perimeter_top_ZN_2" .
  ?point brick:hasLocation ?zone ; brick:hasType brick:Air_Temperature .
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
}

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?s ?p ?o WHERE { ?s ?p ?o . ?s rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(CONTAINS(?l,"Perimeter")) } LIMIT 50
